independence_rules: Second coder must not inspect the first-coder staging file or blind key before locking all rows.
Second coder may inspect only the blind packet, coding instructions, and linked/independently located source documents.
Second coder writes a separate completed file; first-pass records remain immutable.
Agreement is computed only after the completed second-coder file is hashed and locked.

agreement_estimands.admissibility: proportion agreeing whether a sampled source cell contains any admissible control/presence observation
agreement_estimands.actor: exact agreement on actor_id among rows both coders deem admissible
agreement_estimands.observable: exact agreement on the eight-category observable field among rows both coders deem admissible
agreement_estimands.temporal_overlap: whether independently coded date intervals overlap at all
agreement_estimands.spatial_scope: reported descriptively because free-text scopes are not a stable nominal scale
agreement_estimands.confidence: reported descriptively and never used as an agreement gate

adjudication_rules: Every disagreement is retained explicitly; no majority-by-model rule is allowed.
Adjudication must return to the underlying source and record a precise passage/page/paragraph locator.
When two interpretations are both defensible, retain the narrower spatial/temporal claim or mark the cell uncertain rather than forcing agreement.
Rows judged NOT_ADMISSIBLE by either coder receive explicit review before inclusion.
No adjudicated record is converted into district-wide control unless the source directly supports district-wide scope.
No historical predictive rescore, parameter fitting, or core modification is authorized by this adjudication.
confirmatory_construct_use_gate: second-coder file is complete and provenance-bound
all disagreements are adjudicated or explicitly retained as unresolved
final admissible evidence still satisfies the frozen Nepal acquisition coverage gate
construct assessment uses only the source-supported spatial and temporal scopes
